items.source: Returns the native client if available in this vector store implementation. Note on usage: 1. Returns empty Optional when no native client is available 2. Due to Java type erasure, runtime type checking is not possible Example usage: When working with implementation with known native client: Optional client = vectorStore.getNativeClient(); Note: Using Optionalinvalid input: '<'?> will return the native client if one exists, rather than an empty Optional. For type safety, prefer using the specific client type.
items.translation: 返回当前向量存储实现中可用的原生客户端。 使用注意事项：1. 若无可用原生客户端，则返回空 Optional；2. 由于 Java 类型擦除，无法进行运行时类型检查。 使用示例：在与已知原生客户端的实现协作时：Optional client = vectorStore.getNativeClient(); 注意：使用 Optional无效输入：'<'?> 将返回存在的原生客户端，而非空 Optional。为确保类型安全，建议使用特定的客户端类型。

items.source: A vector store implementation that stores and retrieves vectors in a Weaviate database. Note: You can assign arbitrary metadata fields with your Documents. Later will be persisted and managed as Document fields. But only the metadata keys listed in filterMetadataFields can be used for similarity search expression filters.
items.translation: 一个向量存储实现，用于在 Weaviate 数据库中存储和检索向量。 注意：您可以为文档分配任意元数据字段。这些字段稍后将被持久化并作为文档字段进行管理。但只有 filterMetadataFields 中列出的元数据键才能用于相似性搜索表达式过滤器。

items.source:
// Create the vector store with builder
WeaviateVectorStore vectorStore = WeaviateVectorStore.builder(weaviateClient, embeddingModel)
    .options(options)                     	  // Optional: use custom options
    .consistencyLevel(ConsistentLevel.QUORUM)  // Optional: Set consistency level (default: ONE)
    .filterMetadataFields(List.of(             // Optional: Configure filterable metadata fields
        MetadataField.text("country"),
        MetadataField.number("year")
    ))
    .build();
items.translation:
// 使用构建器创建向量存储
WeaviateVectorStore vectorStore = WeaviateVectorStore.builder(weaviateClient, embeddingModel)
    .options(options)                      // 可选：使用自定义选项
    .consistencyLevel(ConsistentLevel.QUORUM)  // 可选：设置一致性级别（默认值：ONE）
    .filterMetadataFields(List.of(             // 可选：配置可过滤的元数据字段
        MetadataField.text("country"),
        MetadataField.number("year")
    ))
    .build();
